alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

logs: EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-c6c48965c-sgdt9: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-c6c48965c-sgdt9_warden-pg(<UUID_1>)
EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-c6c48965c-w5f9f: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-c6c48965c-w5f9f_warden-pg(<UUID_2>)

root_cause.hypothesis: Deploy revision 8 bumped base image from python:3.12-alpine (floating tag) to python:3.12.7-alpine right before crash onset; new patch image likely changed default env/config handling (or picked up stricter validation / different installed config format) causing checkout's startup config validator to reject current config, triggering 'fatal: configuration invalid' and crashloop. Low memory_limit_mib (48) is suspicious but oom_killed_containers=0 rules out OOM as direct cause.
evidence: Deploy at 13:22:55 immediately precedes first crash log at 13:25:54 (~3min gap, consistent with restart backoff)
Both crashing pods (sgdt9, w5f9f) hit identical 'fatal: configuration invalid' error
Image tag changed 3.12-alpine -> 3.12.7-alpine same deploy event, no other deploy in window
crashloop_containers=1, restart_count=11, pods_ready=0 confirms total service outage tied to this revision
ruled_out: OOM kill as cause (oom_killed_containers=0 despite tiny 48MiB limit)
Gradual resource exhaustion/leak (failure is immediate 'fatal', not slow degradation)

proposal.reasoning: Crashloop started right after revision 8 swapped base image from floating python:3.12-alpine to pinned python:3.12.7-alpine. Both pods fail identically with 'fatal: configuration invalid', 100% correlated with deploy timing, not OOM (oom_killed=0). New patch image likely changed default env/config parsing, breaking checkout's config validator. Reverting to prior working image removes the triggering change.
proposal.expected_effect: Pods pick up previous image, config validator passes, pods_ready returns to 2/2, restart_count stops climbing.

reasons: Passed all policies. Held for operator approval before execution.
